title.en: Compare Before and After the Fix

brief.zh: 给两个版本同一组输入。观察 return 的缩进怎样改变累加过程。
brief.en: Give two versions the same input and observe how return’s indentation changes the sum.

concept.zh: 用同一用例比较错误版本和修正版本
concept.en: Use the same case to compare faulty and corrected code

hints.zh: 第一次提交显示错误版本的实际结果，第二次提交显示修复后的结果。
hints.en: The first submission shows what the faulty version returns. The second shows the result after the fix.
